scenes.text: This tutorial covers Database Browser. Browse, filter, query, and export measurements dot db without using the sqlite command line.
Open Database Browser from the Data and batch runs section. Open a spaCR SQLite database and select a table or saved query.
In the main configuration area, configure columns, filters, sorting, row limits, joins, and safe read-only or editable behavior.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. preview queries and preserve object identifiers when exporting or making authorized edits.
When the workflow finishes, filtered tables can be copied or exported while the original database remains traceable.
